Features arguing against IDH mutation are the brainstem/midline epicenter and deep white matter invasion, which are less typical for the common supratentorial IDH-mutant diffuse astrocytoma pattern, and edema crossing midline suggests infiltrative extent. Overall, the T2-FLAIR mismatch and limited enhancement outweigh the atypical location, so IDH-mutant is favored.
